title: Ice storm
tldr: Avoid travel on icy roads and keep away from ice-laden trees and power lines. Prepare for a long outage using safe heat and battery lights. Stay indoors until conditions improve unless your shelter is unsafe.
steps: Even thin ice can make roads and sidewalks unsafe.
Stay clear of branches, wires and roofs shedding ice.
Keep combustion equipment outdoors and maintain working CO alarms.
Plan safe transport to a warm location if heat or essential medical power fails.
next: Use footwear with traction for necessary movement and do not enter areas beneath damaged trees.
watch: Never touch or approach a fallen wire, even if it appears inactive.
